## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, `skip.log` is still archived because you set `default=[]`. This violates `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`: “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the environment include files their configuration intends to omit.
